## Description (説明)
- .vimrc の英語翻訳機能（関数）の vim plugin 化
- .vimrc から英語翻訳機能を取り除いて簡素化

## Objectives / Points (目的・ポイント)
- vim plugin は github のレポジトリで管理する
- .vimrc を簡素に保つ
- vim plugin は現在と同等の機能を保つ

## Expected Outcome (期待される結果)
- github レポジトリで管理された vim plugin の作成
- .vimrc から 関連機能（関数）を取り除いて簡素化

## Notes (補足)
- 今後、gh issue 関連機能（関数郡）も別途 vim plugin 化する予定

title: Turn the English translation function in .vimrc into a Vim plugin
label: enhancement
assignee: @.config/karabiner_elements

## Description
- Turn the English translation function in .vimrc into a Vim plugin.
- Remove the English translation function from .vimrc to simplify it.

## Objectives / Points
- The Vim plugin will be managed in a GitHub repository.
- Keep .vimrc simple.
- The Vim plugin should maintain the same functionality as the current one.

## Expected Outcome
- Creation of a Vim plugin managed in a GitHub repository.
- Simplification of .vimrc by removing the related function.

## Notes
- There are plans to turn the gh issue related functions into a separate Vim plugin in the future.
